title: Requests to keep settings and brief praise
summary: This topic mixes brief praise with feature requests and unclear mentions about keeping settings, systems, or functions active, so the examples do not form a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle generally and express satisfaction with keeping or continuing ownership.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention persistent wipers, door clicking, engine running, climate and mode retention, and requests to keep certain settings permanently, but the snippets are too brief to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: This cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as praise, ownership decisions, wipers, doors, engine behavior, climate controls, and saved settings.
Most examples are very short or lack surrounding context, so sentiment and the underlying issue are often unclear.
The sampled fragments are stratified and are not representative estimates of all G70 reviews.
